preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 10^5.
The integer k is between 1 and the length of the string s.

postconditions.expression: all(len(group) % k != 0 for group in return_value.split())
postconditions.description: No group of k consecutive identical characters remains in the output string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join(char for char, group in ((char, sum(1 for _ in g)) for char, g in itertools.groupby(s)) if group % k != 0)
postconditions.description: The output string is formed by removing groups of k consecutive identical characters from the input string.
